statement: Retain earlier original-quartic results, accepted compatible range condition and unrestricted large-k theorem at their actual scope. The complete 22C8B2 final adds an attained nonlinear compatible mixed-stress projection and optimal lower-model dual defect; paid damped ORIGINAL-energy descent with a geometric rate to each conditional row minimum; exact nonconvexity of the reduced first-row functional; an entire explicit compatible family positive for every independent mean; a fixed-field lower-endpoint mean-regression expansion; and potential-dependent compensation identities that leave the missing weighted work unchanged. The full all-k/all-mean/all-compatible-gradient original inequality remains OPEN, with no actual negative original witness. The bounded compatible search found no negative nomination and establishes no universal positivity. The complete 28DA6F final proves exact potential-law compatibility and original Jacobian-variance decomposition; explicit determinant-minimizing completions for smooth monotone first potentials; actual fixed-first-row original conditional value and strong minimizer limits at k down to 1/3; an actual conditional radial interval with NEGATIVE work but POSITIVE total original gap; an all-profile/all-independent-mean theorem on a global partial-Legendre branch; and one finite exact rational certificate covering EVERY compatible completing second row. Whole ROOT radial-envelope, paid finite outer-work and direct-original-density mean-regression proofs are integrated alongside it. The unrestricted all-k/all-mean/all-compatible-gradient original theorem remains OPEN, no actual negative original field. Earlier unrestricted large-k theorem and accepted range condition retained.
